column2: Congratulations, you have received a grand price of 100K, please press the following link to receive the price!!!

Purolator Shipment Notification Our delivery staff were unable to complete your package drop-off on Aug 4, 2026, because a physical signature from the recipient is required. Please submit your desired options prior to Aug 4, 2026, so we can manage the delivery: • Select a rearranged arrival time that fits your convenience • Choose to retrieve your package from a nearby Purolator office Update your shipment preferences here: https://scam-example.buzz/en If the URL fails to open, send "Y" as a reply, close this message window, and restart it — the link should become operational then. If your instructions are not provided by the deadline, your item could be returned to the original sender.
